record.paper: A note on directed analogues of the Sidorenko and forcing conjectures

dossier_meta.paper: A note on directed analogues of the Sidorenko and forcing conjectures
dossier_meta.statement_text: If $B$ is a bipartite oriented graph with a homomorphism $B \to \vec{K}_2$, then $B$ has the directed Sidorenko property.
dossier_meta.context_text: Observation 3.1 establishes that having a homomorphism to a directed edge is a necessary condition for the directed Sidorenko property. The authors conjecture this condition is also sufficient for bipartite oriented graphs, giving a directed analogue of Sidorenko's conjecture.
